japanese_name: 日除けテント・天幕・金物
components: 18 alternating vertical stripe panels (hunter green and warm cream) across canopy slope and hanging valance
Watertight solid canvas volume with offset underside lining (zero see-through, zero co-planar Z-fighting)
Scalloped wave hem bottom edging with white cloth piping tape
Left and right side triangular canvas valance flaps
Tubular black painted iron front crossbar and rear wall mounting bar (38mm diameter)
4 heavy diagonal cantilever steel support struts with welded elbow joints and turnbuckle tensioners
Heavy iron wall mounting baseplates bolted with 4 hex lag screws into the dark yakisugi timber lintel
